comments.note: The context object has two consecutive computed sections: one for version/model/cc_model, then another for standalone name suffix (conditional spread). These interleave computed fields — consider consolidating into a single clearly-labelled block for readability. Non-blocking.

The fallback chain `sharedMeta.default_model || sharedMeta.cc_model || 'inherit'` is correct since cc_model is always set in _shared.yaml. However, an inline comment explaining why cc_model serves as a middle fallback (bridges old-style configs that only have cc_model without default_model) would improve maintainability.

comments.note: Edge-case: if a future _shared.yaml omits default_model but has cc_model, personas without per-persona model would resolve to the cc_model string (e.g. 'inherit') instead of a real model name. summary: Reviewed scripts/build-personas.js model resolution implementation. The two-level resolution chain (persona.model → sharedMeta.default_model || sharedMeta.cc_model || 'inherit' for model; persona.cc_model ?? resolved model for ccModel) is logically correct and idiomatic. The !== undefined guard correctly distinguishes absent fields from explicit falsy values. Post-spread placement of computed model/cc_model in the context object correctly prevents ...persona from clobbering resolved values. Generated output verified: Planner/PM emit Claude Opus 4.6 in both VS Code and Claude Code frontmatter; Developer/QA/etc emit Claude Sonnet 4.6 via default_model fallback. Standalone backward compatibility confirmed — cc_model resolves to 'inherit' via sharedMeta.cc_model path since standalone _shared.yaml has no default_model. FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_VSCODE model field correctly positioned after description. ccFrontmatterFields() and FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC are unchanged as required by AC #5. Persona manifest (api-surface.md, data-flows.md) reflects the new model resolution contract. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: scripts/build-personas.js ~L574: The fallback chain `sharedMeta.default_model || sharedMeta.cc_model || 'inherit'` lacks an inline comment explaining why cc_model serves as a mid-level fallback (it bridges configs that only have cc_model without default_model). A one-line comment here would reduce the learning curve for future maintainers — raised by Developer, echoed here.

scripts/build-personas.js ~L640-660: Context object has two distinct computed sections (version/model/cc_model then the conditional standalone name spread). Consolidating all computed fields into a single clearly-labelled block would improve readability at a glance. Non-blocking.

personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md Layer 3 comment for cc_model reads 'persona.cc_model ?? resolved model ?? _shared.cc_model', which implies _shared.cc_model is an independent fallback from model. In the code, _shared.cc_model is consumed inside the model resolution chain, not as a direct ccModel fallback. The comment is functionally accurate but slightly overstates the chain — a minor doc clarification for the next documentation pass. Non-blocking.

QA observation echoed: a console.warn when the fallback reaches 'inherit' during a ledger suite build (where a real model is expected) would surface mis-configured _shared.yaml files immediately rather than silently producing 'inherit' in frontmatter. Low effort, high debuggability gain for future maintainers.
